def test_run_stm_keeps_shrunk_micro_batch_across_epochs(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    torch.manual_seed(15)
    config = StmConfig(epochs=3, micro_batch=8, loops=1)
    model = tiny_model()
    optimizer = torch.optim.NAdam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
    pool = torch.randint(0, 257, (16, 17))
    oom_count = {"n": 0}
    real = stm_module.per_sample_loss

    def fake(model_arg: MythosMini, batch: torch.Tensor, loops: int, dtype: torch.dtype) -> torch.Tensor:
        if batch.shape[0] > 4:
            oom_count["n"] += 1
            raise torch.OutOfMemoryError
        return real(model_arg, batch, loops, dtype)

    monkeypatch.setattr(stm_module, "per_sample_loss", fake)
    survivors, settled = run_stm(
        model, optimizer, pool, config, torch.float32, lambda e, p, m: None
    )
    assert settled == 4
    assert oom_count["n"] == 1
EOF
